body:
Hi, this space is for bug reports only. It is not a platform to ask any questions you have about the community. This question is more appropriate for the contact email address contact@godotengine.org

You may also be interested in reading our Code of Conduct which explicitly lays out the expectations we have for people participating in official Godot community spaces https://godotengine.org/code-of-conduct/

To answer your question in short, people are banned from community platforms if they have clearly breached the code of conduct. In most cases, bans are temporary unless the user repeatedly breaches the code of conduct. A ban from a community space does not stop you from using Godot, accessing the latest versions, or even accessing the source code and modifying it yourself. It just stops you from interacting in the community space that you were banned from. 

If you have further questions, please follow up by contacting the email address above.
